arms.C: Exact previous continuation incumbent; strong no-edit model baseline
arms.E: Anchored one-step targets, occupancy mixture, direct solve, five-alpha own-value selection; primary weight arm
arms.EA: Unanchored raw one-step Q_C targets, occupancy mixture, direct solve and identical five-alpha selection
arms.EU: Anchored one-step targets, uniform full support, direct solve and identical five-alpha selection
arms.E_gated: E if the fixed new validation gate accepts, else exact complete C
arms.G: Same as E with matched quadratic PGD and identical five-alpha selection
arms.G_gated: G if the same fixed gate accepts, else exact complete C
arms.J: No weight edit: full checkpoint-own-law Bellman program; planning control
arms.M: Exact previously frozen DQ old full-optimal-Q MSE model; no new fitting/selection
arms.P: No weight edit: C continuation plus own analytic terminal posterior; program control
arms.R: Single random edit norm-matched to final E

holdout.OOD_scope: OOD is relative to original TRAIN; new validation exposes that distribution, TEST is new instances of that exposed domain.
holdout.exclusion: Exact schedule-content comparison against all2416 available same-task historical unique schedules and all new schedules; collision stops entire run, no replacement.
holdout.failed_gate: Reject and serialize full C; require canonical model SHA and complete deterministic gzip file bytes to match C. Accepted candidates have restoration=null/not applicable.
holdout.gate: Per fit E/G endpoint solver must converge, neither domain may lose versus C, equal-domain mean gain >=.005. EU/EA/M/R/P/J remain secondary frozen controls without validation tuning.
holdout.generator: PCG64 full SHA256 integer from canonical [protocol_sha,fit,split,domain,'public-schedule']; original public domains and six-tick schedule sampling order.
ordering: all 5 fits, all 100 path heads, all TRAIN selection and raw models frozen
holdout.unknown_history: Unseen external trials and unavailable original formal-confirmation content are not excluded by a known-content hash registry.

independent_verification.holdout_replay: All4960 held-out world/arm pairs through a separate literal-head, recursive eight-behavior evaluator; require node count equality and absolute metric difference <=2e-13; shared original core/law source explicitly retained.
independent_verification.source: verify_records.py; it does not import task_graph.py or run_experiment.py
independent_verification.stored_records: Model preservation, rational norm membership, finite path identity, selection, seeds/content exclusion, local event order, exact failed-gate rollback and closed-form-df4 interval recomputation.
independent_verification.train_replay: Every6400 TRAIN world/path pair through the old pinned recursive executor; require exact float utility equality, not the new DAG code.

inference.controls_and_ablations: All raw/gated arms and behavior/error metrics retained; other95% intervals descriptive only, no additional confirmatory claim.
inference.interval: Paired Student-t df4 across five old fit means, two-sided Bonferroni-two familywise alpha.05; conditional model-assumption interval for this fixed training family, not distribution-free or new-fit replication.
inference.qualification: All E source/norm/numerical gates and both primary lower bounds strictly >.005. Record G/EU/EA numerical failures separately; they do not become qualified candidates.

information_boundary.evaluator: Independent pinned environment transition tables and original fitted confusion; truth used only after all candidates freeze.
information_boundary.inputs: All original 64 TRAIN public schedules per fit and exact stored checkpoint transition/emission tables; input package excludes original Q/posterior/label/VAL rows.
information_boundary.law_authority: Exact supplied model tables; no idealized regeneration from nominal physics.
information_boundary.teacher: Q_C(s,a): immediate task reward/fee followed by fixed C under checkpoint own law, with all finite transitions integrated.
information_boundary.terminal_anchor: a_T is first argmax of unchanged C STOP/SUBMIT scores. Y_a=T_pred(a_T)+Q_C(s,a)-T_own(a_T). All three terminal actions are always legal in the pinned task.

optimization.declared_radius: L2 change <=0.5||C_Q||; solver radius uses inward factor (1-1e-8); exact rational checks on actually stored IEEE F64 differences.
optimization.direct: Existing spectral secular trust-region solver with independent Cholesky/KKT diagnostics; no gradient steps.
optimization.gradient: Same quadratic as E, same data/start/radius; projected gradient at 1/L, own Frank-Wolfe gap <=1e-8, maximum100000 steps; no access to direct optimum for stopping.
optimization.random: One PCG64 seed from [protocol_sha,fit,'single-final-E-norm-matched-random']; random delta norm matches final selected and serialized E. If E is zero, R is C. No random search or alpha selection.
optimization.selection: Every path arm separately picks the first exact maximum of mean complete own-law TRAIN utility among its five stored-F64 heads; ascending alpha means ties pick smallest alpha. No tolerance-based tie adaptation.
optimization.stored_path_definition: stored_point(C_Q,alpha*(endpoint_Q-C_Q),same safe radius); actual serialized head, norm and reconstructed full-model identity retained before scoring.

prior_work_not_repeated: The old 125-point three-bias grid and old full-optimal-Q uniform MSE compilation are known failures; this is one fixed new hypothesis, not a search over more post-holdout hypotheses.
purpose: Test whether terminal-anchored one-step incumbent advantages and own occupancy weighting produce a useful pure continuation-head direction, selected only by complete own-law TRAIN utility.

reporting.compute_comparison: Direct versus PGD is only the matched147-parameter fixed-feature quadratic and finite path; report shared preprocessing and whole experiment separately, no complete-training speedup claim.
reporting.controller_cost_limit: Receipt controller CPU covers main body only, after imports and before final receipt write. That missing overhead, agent/editor cost, unknown earlier trials and base-model training are not recoverable full costs.
reporting.costs: Input preparation, semantic checks, all shared graph/feature/own-target work, all solver and finite path candidates, serialization, controls, validation, TEST and independent verification measured separately. J includes own planning/verification/serialization/load; feature caches are cold separately for each held-out arm.
reporting.utility: Original finite task includes requested-read, repair and simulated elapsed fees. Actual CPU has no measured economic conversion; full NDU economic net gain is not qualified.

resource_caps.RSS_scope: Measured peak RSS checked at budget points, not a hard virtual address limit.
resource_caps.failure: Stop and preserve all partial files/costs; do not reduce fits/worlds, tune another candidate or rerun changed scientific source under this protocol.

scope_limits: Finite fixed-deadline sign task only; not first-passage or financial Call/Put repair
No live Trader or private market data and no remote training
No full-network continuous global-optimality claim; only selection from fixed finite directions
No weight gain attribution to P/J program changes
No result-driven extra candidate round; defects/results remain visible
PGD is gradient optimization, but this is not comparison with complete base retraining

training.endpoint_representation: Frozen 85 input to tanh48 hidden features plus bias; only first three rows of the 4x49 augmented head can change.
training.mixed_weight: Per world, 0.9 incumbent-own-law occupancy normalized over continuation-eligible states plus 0.1 uniform over all eligible full states; divide equally over legal continuation actions and over 64 worlds.
training.policy_execution: Pinned checked-head replay: original explicit F64 reduction of augmented [hidden,1] features; this is not an F32/native production qualification.
training.reference: Each TRAIN C value must match the old recursive checked-head executor exactly; candidate score traversal uses actual stored F64 head argmax decisions.
training.state_identity: Canonical full original state including sunk charges, observation history, pending I/O, elapsed time and budgets.
training.state_order: Pinned deterministic DFS insertion order; topology is stable tick sort; every continuation advances exactly one tick.
training.teacher_opportunity_diagnostic: TRAIN-only exact anchored-policy rollout recorded as a diagnostic; it is not a new held-out arm or a weight edit.
training.uniform_control: Same eligible-state/legal-continuation normalization with occupancy mixture zero.
